snippet.title: Hana no Keiji: Kumo no Kanata ni - SNES Longplay
snippet.description:
Title: Hana no Keiji: Kumo no Kanata ni
Platform: Super Nintendo (SNES)
Type: Longplay
Developer: TOSE
Publisher: Yojigen
Release: November 18, 1994
Footage captured by: @GMBLongplays 

Hana no Keiji: Kumo no Kanata ni is a 1994 fighting game for the Super Famicom, based on the manga Hana no Keiji by Tetsuo Hara. The game features one-on-one battles with a cast of samurai and warriors from Japan's Sengoku period. It has a unique aesthetic inspired by the manga’s art style, with large, detailed character sprites and dramatic special moves. The gameplay includes a spirit gauge system that enhances attacks and counters, making for strategic combat. While it never received an official Western release, it remains a cult classic among fans of historical fighting games.

SNES Longplays - https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLlERJYeRTVpAOMrdtuUSN-zsJn1TWAf7L
